days.title: Volcanoes and Ancient Craters
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Astroni
stops.detail: Remains of lakes are found inside the craters of Astroni and Solfatara.

stops.name: Eremo dei Camaldoli
stops.detail: One of the sighting points for birds of prey is located on the panoramic terrace of the Camaldoli hermitage situated at the top of the hill of the same name.

days.title: Archaeology and Coastal Lakes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: lago d'Averno
stops.detail: Some are of volcanic formation (Lake Avernus), while others are lagoonal (Lake Lucrino, Lake Miseno, Lake Fusaro); they have different compositional characteristics, with some being brackish (Fusaro) and others fresh (Avernus).

stops.name: Cuma
stops.detail: In Roman times, the Phlegraean Fields were an urban-territorial system of fundamental importance, hosting the port and commercial city of Puteoli, the military ports of Lucrino and Capo Miseno, the system of imperial and thermal villas of Baia (Bacoli)-Bauli and the "Greek" city of Cuma.
